<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/admin/backups/{file}/restore"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Signed-in admin only — an API token gets `403`, even with admin access.
Replaces everything (every row; media the backup needs that storage
lacks come from the backups mirror) with the backup. Runs in the
background: first a safety backup of the current state (if it fails,
nothing is restored), then the restore. Meanwhile every other API
request gets `503` with `code: RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS`. Afterwards every
session has ended, the caller's included; poll
`GET /api/auth/restore-status` for the outcome. Credential settings
are kept unless the restored settings change their destination.
Rate-limited to 3 requests per hour per IP.
